Drak Temple Roof Block.description: A building block that makes it easier to create harsh and visually enticing edges.

Draped In Envy.description: The muted gray and silvery sheen cannot hide the underlying seething emerald-green envy. This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

Dried Banana Chips.description: These conserved banana chips do not regenerate as much health as the raw fruit. However, the duration of their effect lasts longer - and the crunch is nice too.

Dried Fur.description: After drying the Animal Fur on the Drying Rack, it becomes sturdier and more durable for a longer period of time.

Dried Purple Berry.description: When conserved, the Dried Purple Berry do not regenerate as much Health as the Purple berries. However, the duration lasts longer.

Drying Rack.description: Uses salt to conserve furs for further usage. Place near a Hunter.

Dune Armadillo Feeder.description: A feeding device that holds Dune Armadillo food.

Dune Armadillo Food.description: Nutritious Dune Armadillo food for tame animals on your farm.

Dune Armadillo Food Bait.description: Food for attracting and taming a Dune Armadillo. To tame an animal, approach it carefully while sneaking. Throw the bait food near the animal to attract its attention. Pet the animal while it's feeding and repeat the process until it is docile. Once tame, the animal can be picked up.

Dusk Amethyst.description: A deep, royal purple dominates this color palette. The color seems to draw you in like the glimmering inside of an amethyst geode. This color palette can be made with Albaneve Summits materials.

Dusk Garden.description: Ancient and earthy, cut through with a breath of fresh thyme.

Ectoplasm.description: A strange material extracted from ectoplasm fragments. It was filtered through cloth and coal but still smells odd.

Ectoplasm Aggregate.description: A massive formation of ectoplasm crystals, pulsing with energy. An enormous life force is trapped within. and has been for a very long time.

Ectoplasm Block.description: An ominous, green glowing building block made from ectoplasm. The construction is reminiscent of stained glass windows.

Ectoplasm Cluster.description: A cluster of ectoplasm crystals. It holds immense magical powers inside.

Ectoplasm Crystal.description: A sizeable ectoplasm crystal. Its properties allow it to store life force for eons.

Ectoplasm Fragment.description: A small crystallized ectoplasm. It contains a tiny bit of life energy

Ectoplasm Gem.description: A facetted gemstone made from refined frozen ectoplasm.

Ectoplasm Press.description: A special crafting station that allows its devious users to create otherworldly ingredients.

Ectoplasm Shard.description: A good amount of crystallized ectoplasm. Inside slumbers the essence of vitality.

Ectoplasm Soup.description: Unnerving goo. It bestows great powers on those who eat it.

Eggs.description: A great source of protein that enhances the muscle mass. Best consumed before a good exercise.

Electric Initialiser.description: An electrifying wand that was previously used to start engines and machinery in an instant. The air crackles around it, and it has an odd shape.

Electric Nerve.description: An electrified strand of nerves. It's a sought-after magical ingredient needed in some spell recipes.

Ember Carapace.description: Heat-hardened scales from a carapace creature of Cinder's Cradle. Blades skate off its surface, and flames find nothing to catch.

Emberfin.description: This striking red fish is marked with black stripes. Its shimmering scales resemble cooling embers, earning it the name "Emberfin".

Emberguard Boots.description: Imposing boots that leave a deep imprint wherever they step. They possess additional plating towards the outer sides, protecting the wearer from low blows.

Emberguard Chestplate.description: A venerated chestplate that reflects the light of the Mother Flame on its polished, angular surface. Anyone who brandishes this armor vows to be the sword of the Flame and the guard of the light.

Emberguard Gloves.description: Proud gloves forged from the finest celestium. Two metal ridges protrude from each spine, enabling the warrior wearing them to push their way through hordes of enemies if needed.

Emberguard Helmet.description: The crest atop this helmet stretches upwards, caressing the skies like the crown of an Ancient Spire and willing to frame within it the light of the sun.

Emberguard Pants.description: A pattern ripples across the fabric, creating subtle peaks and valleys as fingers draw across it.

Emberguard Shield.description: An agile shield that feels as though it could be used well offensively. Three small dots adorn its heart, representing humanity, the Ancients, and the Flameborn between.

Embervale Miniature Showcase.description: A showcase for displaying the Embervale miniature.

Emerald Forest.description: Lush and lively like the Nomad Highlands flora before the drought. This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

Enhanced Spiked Club.description: The most basic weaponry, enhanced to be more effective and durable.

Enormous Magic Chest.description: A big and heavy chest that offers fantastic storage space for countless items.

Enshrouded Cyclops Eye.description: A massive, unblinking eye brimming with Shroud power. Its overwhelming energy is a critical element in crafting exotic high-level armor.

Enshrouded Ice.description: Frozen, enshrouded liquid that's cool to the touch. It's unusable by itself, but can be processed into different materials in crafting.

Enshrouded Oil.description: Its uses are unknown even to the creator itself, but it definitely didn't help the skin of the Fell!

Entangle I.description: Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration. Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted.

Entangle II.description: Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration. Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted.

Entangle III.description: Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration. Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted.

Epic Fishing Bait.description: Bait that increases the chance of catching epic fish.

Epic Fishing Bait II.description: This bait tastes so good, so when a fish bites, it will definitely be an epic fish local to Cinder's Cradle.

Eternal Acid Bite.description: Banned in most mystic circles, this spell serves as an infinite well of acid to envenom foes. It's bite is most deadly, so use with care

Eternal Arc Lightning II.description: Releases continuous lightning strikes that can arc to multiple other close targets. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Eternal Ball Lightning I.description: Conjures a slow moving ball of lightning that travels unhindered through enemies and some obstacles. It continuously releases lightning strikes to nearby enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Eternal Blizzard I.description: Conjures a freezing storm that continuously deals damage to all enemies inside the area and applies a slow debuff to them.

Eternal Blizzard II.description: Conjures a freezing storm that continuously deals damage to all enemies inside the area and applies a slow debuff to them.

Eternal Bonestorm I.description: Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force.

Eternal Bonestorm II.description: Conjures a flurry homing bone projectiles that hunt down enemies with crushing force.

Eternal Chain Heal.description: An eternal spell which distributes great healing that jumps to nearby friends.

Eternal Chain Heal II.description: Releases a mending ray that automatically seeks nearby allies.

Eternal Chain Lightning.description: An eternal spell which releases a powerful lightning strike that shocks nearby enemies and jumps to others nearby.Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the Eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.

Eternal Chain Lightning III.description: Releases a lightning strike at an enemy that can arc to multiple other nearby targets. It also deals Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Eternal Ember Arrow I.description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's blazing hot.

Eternal Ember Arrow II.description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's blazing hot.

Eternal Ember Arrow III.description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's blazing hot.

Eternal Entangle.description: Grows entangling roots in an area that apply a debuff to enemies which prevents them from moving for a short duration. Rooted enemies are still able to perform attacks and bigger ones are slowed instead of rooted.

Eternal Fire Totem I.description: Summons a totem that launches fiery projectiles at enemies and explodes when it expires. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Fire Totem II.description: Summons a totem that launches fiery projectiles at enemies and explodes when it expires. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Fireball.description: This spell is fueled by the eternal Flame and serves as unlimited magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a large area.Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the Eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.

Eternal Fireball II.description: Superior magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a medium area.Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the Eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.

Eternal Fireball III.description: Ignites a fireball projectile that erupts upon impact and deals damage in an area.

Eternal Frost Arrow II.description: An arrow that was touched by eternity. It's ice cold to the touch.

Eternal Frost Arrow III.description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's ice-cold to the touch.

Eternal Giant Bone Arrow I.description: An eternal bone arrow that's overgrown with green crystals.

Eternal Giant Bone Arrow II.description: An eternal bone arrow that's overgrown with green crystals.

Eternal Heal Beam Channel.description: Continuously heal a target in a beam up to 20 meters away.Channel Spell: Hold the input to channel over time. Equip the spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.Eternal Spell: Does not deplete. Equip the Eternal spell and use mana to cast it with a staff.

Eternal Heal Beam II.description: Releases an aimed mending ray that continuously heals allies within.

Eternal Heal Cascade II.description: Releases continuous healing projectiles that automatically seek you and your allies.

Eternal Heal Channel.description: An eternal spell which heals all allies in need.

Eternal Hollow Wretch I.description: Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Hollow Wretch II.description: Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Ice Bolt.description: An eternal version of the Ice Bolt. The spell damages enemies upon impact and slows them afterwards.

Eternal Ice Bolt II.description: An eternal version of the Ice Bolt. The spell damages enemies upon impact and slows them afterwards.

Eternal Ice Totem I.description: Summons a totem that launches icy projectiles at enemies, applying a slow debuff to them. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Ice Totem II.description: Summons a totem that launches icy projectiles at enemies, applying a slow debuff to them. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Light Burst.description: This eternal is imbued with the power of light. When cast, a bright burst of radiance flashes before you and pushes back enemies.

Eternal Light Burst II.description: Ignites a flash of light, bright enough to push back enemies around the caster. It also deals Stamina Damage based on your Intelligence attribute to Shroud infested enemies which fills their Stun Bar.

Eternal Lightning Channel.description: Umlimited magical ammunition that continuously channels powerful lightning strikes. It shocks enemies by jumping between them and deals stamina damage.

Eternal Pillar Of Flames I.description: Ignites an area with flames that continuously damage enemies within. It also applies a burn debuff to them.

Eternal Shock Totem.description: Summons a totem that launches shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar. Maximum amount of summoned totems is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Eternal Shock Wisp I.description: Conjures a charged wisp that trails you for a short duration. It hurls shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Eternal Shock Wisp II.description: Conjures a charged wisp that trails you for a short duration. It hurls shock projectiles at enemies that also deal Stamina Damage which fills the enemy's Stun Bar.

Eternal Shroud Beam.description: Releases an aimed ray of disastrous Shroud that continuously deals damage to enemies within.

Eternal Shroud Meteor.description: Calls down a disastrous Shroud Meteor on up to five foes.

Eternal Voltaic Arrow I.description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's charged with electricity.

Eternal Voltaic Arrow II.description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's charged with electricity.

Eternal Voltaic Arrow III.description: An arrow that was embraced by eternity. It's charged with electricity.

Ethereal Plane.description: This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

Evergreen Tree Seedling.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

Excellent Ectoplasm.description: A slimy broth made from crushed ectoplasm crystals. It's "safe to consume".

Excellent Ectoplasm Soup.description: Even the most carefully cooked Ectoplasm Soup still tastes a little bit...fermented.

Excellent Fishing Rod.description: A fine fishing rod that makes catching as easy as possible. You can reel in fish faster and hold out longer if they put up a fight.

Exceptional Ectoplasm.description: Despite its wild mixture, it still looks appealing. It's one of those things that isn't edible, yet you still want to take a bite out of it.

Exceptional Ectoplasm Soup.description: It contains ice and gentian. a failed attempt at herbal iced tea? Its strengths certainly do not lie in its taste.

Exotic Fruit Salad.description: A vibrant mix of Prickle Pearl, Bloomheart Fruit, Strawberries, and Dates. Sweet, exotic, and refreshingly simple.

Exploding Arrow IV.description: A Special Arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with immense firepower.

Explorer Boots.description: The wilderness will bend to your will in no time when you face it wearing these sturdy, bite-proof boots.

Explorer Coat.description: The backpack provides ample space for storing unknown flora or newly discovered artifacts while adventuring!

Explorer Gloves.description: Fantastic Gloves for digging up secrets, uncovering treasures, or cartographing never-before-seen lands!

Explorer Helmet.description: Dashing headgear with a set of goggles. They protect the wearer's eyes from vapors and water but were also used while gliding on wind currents back in the day.

Explorer Pants.description: Even after many weeks on the road, these pants will still be comfortable and in good shape.

Explosive Arrow I.description: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise.

Explosive Arrow II.description: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with improved firepower.

Explosive Arrow III.description: A special arrow that delivers an explosive surprise. Strikes with greatly improved firepower.

Explosive Barrel.description: A decorative item for everyone's home.

Explosive Crawler.description: An explosive critter bomb that can be thrown

Explosive Powder Ball.description: An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

Explosive Powder Ball Net.description: An explosive with astounding power that can be thrown.

Extraordinary Ectoplasm.description: A curious blend. Ground, mixed and left to settle. The important thing is that it works. Probably.

Extraordinary Ectoplasm Soup.description: A thick, viscous soup made from volatile extoplasm. It tastes vaguely minty.

Extraordinary Glider.description: This Glider will allow you to travel extraordinarily long distances.

Fabric.description: A sturdy material that was woven out of linen. It revolutionized the clothing industry due to its flexibility and durability. It looks better as well.

Fae Deer Farmer Boots.description: At first glance, these brown leather boots appear ordinary. A closer inspection reveals the cloven segment towards the front, which leaves "hoov"-like prints in the mud.

Fae Deer Farmer Gloves.description: Two-toned leather gloves with light stitching. Their pattern gives them an almost whimsical feel.

Fae Deer Farmer Hood.description: A fanciful hood with expressive animal ears and a draping cape. It's made from layers of faintly dotted fur and is well-suited for walking among the Fae Deer as a trusted friend and companion.

Fae Deer Farmer Overalls.description: A farmhand's overalls. The deep pockets are very helpful when gathering herbs or storing animal feed.

Fae Deer Farmer Shirt.description: A short-sleeved linen shirt that's topped with an orange fur cape. The cape flows down the wearer's back and ends in pieces that wave in the wind like a tail.

Fae Deer Feeder.description: A feeding device that holds Fae Deer food.

Fae Deer Food.description: Nutritious Fae Deer food for tame animals on your farm.

Fae Deer Food Bait.description: Food for attracting and taming a Fae Deer.

Fae Deer Pillow.description: A decorative pillow that's been adorned with a Fae Deer motif. It seems to be running wild through the wind and bushes.

Fancy Stone Block.description: A stone block often used for building sturdy soundproof walls.

Farm Animal Pillow.description: A cozy bed for farm animals.

Farm Soil.description: Healthy soil that will increase the growing speed of most plants.

Feather.description: A feather of a bird or creatures of some kind. Weighing next to nothing, it has to be useful for something.

Fell Confusion Pheromones.description: Can be thrown to create a Pheromone Cloud that confuses Fell enemies, who run around in panic when affected.

Fell Crimson Critter Queen Head.description: It looks oddly similar to the Fell Critter Queen, just a different color.

Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy.description: Her red glowing head is smaller than your memory suggested and her mandibles less threatening.

Fell Critter Queen Head.description: The Fell Critter Queen Head looks strangely small without the bulk that had once followed behind it.

Fell Critter Queen Trophy.description: The Fell Critter Queen's antennas are stiff with age, and her curved, fang-like mandibles still frame her mouth. You don't feel terror when looking at them now; they seem almost delicate to your touch.

Fell Curse Cleansing Tonic.description: Removes Fell Curse upon use. Also applies a buff that prevents the curse from affecting the user for an hour.

Fell Cyclops Head.description: The head of a Shroud infested Cyclops. It has pretty bad breath, even now.

Fell Cyclops Trophy.description: A giant trophy, weighing countless pounds. Mounting this on the wall is no easy task.

Fell Dragon Youngling Head.description: Its head alone weighs a monstrous amount. the shimmering scales are ice-cold.

Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy.description: A lonely soul, brought low by the shroud - and set free by your blade.

Fell Fashion.description: Look lole a Fell Foe, but make it fashion. This blue color palette mirrors the hues of the Shroud, with a touch of aquamarine added. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Fell Heart.description: The faded heart of a Fell Foe. Its potent essence is key in crafting resilient armor and powerful healing spells.

Fell Monstrosity Head.description: Despair, hatred, loneliness... It grasps at anything to fill the void and leaves nothing but dust.

Fell Monstrosity Trophy.description: Inside, you can see nothingness. The absence of matter - of sanity and sanctum.

Fell Sicklescythe Head.description: There's still a faint glow behind its eyes. Hopefully, they won't follow your every move.

Fell Sicklescythe Trophy.description: Sometimes, the muscles around the eyes still twitch. It's natural, and not worrying. Mostly.

Fell Striker Head.description: The head of a Fell Striker. The eyes have been fully absorbed into fungal growth... so they're blinded by more than rage.

Fell Striker Trophy.description: This fight made you stop believing in safe corners. You can be sure that he always closes the gap between you two. Maybe nailed to your walls, he will finally leave you be.

Fell Thunderbrute Head.description: Its brain has been replaced by fungi and slush, but it's still tremendously heavy. The face is permanently petrified with a bitter expression.

Fell Thunderbrute Trophy.description: Mount it inside your halls to honor the Flame!

Fell Wispwyvern Head.description: When its luminous brood skipped over the waves near Pikemead's Reach, it was seen as a good omen. Unfortunately, no being, no matter how small, escapes the corrupting grasp of the Shroud.

Fell Wispwyvern Trophy.description: The change of tides was not kind to this creature. Perhaps it can finally rest.

Fenrig's Axe.description: An axe made for cutting down trees. Slightly less effective for fighting off wolves.

Fern Pot.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

Fertile Altered Dirt.description: A mix of soil, rock, and sediment.

Fertile Blackmire Dirt.description: A mix of soil, rock and sediment.

Fertilised Farm Soil.description: Healthy, fertilized soil that greatly increases the growing speed of plants.

Fireball II.description: Advanced magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a medium area.

Fireball IV.description: Superior magical ammunition to ignite a mighty fireball that erupts upon impact, dealing damage in a medium area.

Fired Brick.description: A shiny red brick that is crafted by hardening Lump of Clay under a heat even a Flameborn has issues with.

Fired Bricks Block.description: A block made of Fired Brick. It has a dull red color.

Firefly Standing Lamp.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home.

Firefly Wall Lamp.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home.

Fireplace.description: A fireplace that will provide warmth once placed in your home. It's simple, but sufficient for cooking one - ingredient meals and gaining the Rested buff

Fish Bones.description: Small fish bones that can be used in crafting. They feel brittle in your hands, but they'd be a terrible pain if stuck in your throat.

Fish Chowder.description: A hearty, creamy soup made with tender chunks of fish and fresh vegetables.

Fish Cutlet.description: Fish cut into thick slices, be aware of the the bones, but you can still enjoy it.

Fish Drying Rack.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Fish Filet.description: The Filet of an epic fish, don't worry about any fish bones, they have been thoroughly removed.

Fish Poison Gland.description: Potent in small doses. A staple ingredient for poison-based concoctions.

Fish Scales.description: The scales are still warm when removed from the fish. They never fully cool and are popular under fire mages for obvious reasons.

Fish Tacos.description: Crispy fish tacos filled with a hearty plantain rice.

Fish Teeth.description: The threatening teeth of a fish that is no threat anymore.

Fish Trophy Board.description: A wall-mounted board that lets you display all your fishing achievements.

Flag Pole II.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Flag Pole III.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Flame Altar.description: Place this Flame Altar above the Shroud to mark your home. Build inside the marked area around the Flame Altar.

Flame Arcanist Boots.description: Pointy-toed shoes that curl upwards ever so slightly near the front. They feel nice and cool on the feet.

Flame Arcanist Chest.description: An admiral blue-colored garment often worn by magic scholars who revere the Mother Flame. The cape attached to the shoulders falls in layers and ends in uneven trim, dancing like little spouts of fire as it moves in the wind.

Flame Arcanist Gloves.description: Gilded gloves that brandish both royal blue and gold. They're emblazoned with long, metal claws that tip the gloves.

Flame Arcanist Hat.description: A voluptuous, pointed wizard hat! The crowning glory of clothing for the magically inclined.

Flame Arcanist Pants.description: An assortment of dark layers that protect the wearer's legs from becoming singed, scorched, or incinerated when conjuring fire magic.

Flame Mosaic Showcase.description: A useful frame that can hold the pieces to a Flame mosaic. It must be placed on the ground.

Flammable Goo.description: A sticky and highly flammable substance. Handle with care!

Flare Arrow.description: Scouting ahead can be quite challenging, especially in the dark. The Flare Arrow leaves a flare at the point of impact, spending a little light.

Flask of the Fell.description: The Shroud grants power to not only the Fell, but to whoever drinks from this flask.

Flat Bread.description: A simple meal, granting a lasting Melee Damage boost upon consumption. It tastes better in combination with other things, though.

Flax.description: A popular plant due to its strong fibers. It can be used to make linen.

Flax Seedling.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

Flightless Redtail Pillow.description: A comfortable pillow with a bird on it. The bird may not be able to fly, but it still looks stylish!

Flint.description: A mix of flint and basalt, with a hint of faded lavender. This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

Flint Arrow.description: A slightly enhanced version of the Wooden Arrow, reinforced with small pieces of flint at the tip.

Flintstone.description: A soft small rock that became famous for its ability to release sparks. It has been associated with the Flame ever since

Floor Drain.description: This drain will remove any water above it. Can be placed on the floor.

Flour.description: Flour that can be created by grinding Wheat Grains to dust.

Flower Snake.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Flower Soil.description: The perfect soil for growing beautiful flowers.

Flower Vase.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Flower Wreath.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Flute.description: A flute carved bone. You can use it to make music.

Food Plate.description: A wooden plate to display cooked food on a table.

Forest Beet.description: The edible root of a forest plant. Not all that sustaining on its own. Maybe good as an ingredient?

Forge.description: A workplace that will enable new crafting possibilities for the Blacksmith

Forgotten Library.description: The warm and dusty green hues remind you of old leather-bound books with frayed and copper clasps. This color palette can be made with Nomad Highlands materials.

Fossil Showcase (2 Medium Slots).description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

Fossil Showcase (2 Small Slots).description: This is a showcase for Fossil Collection Items usually found in quarries, material veins, or dig sites.

Fossilized Bone.description: Over the years, untouched by anyone, the bones of all kind of magical creatures have hardened and turned to stone. A rare material due to its limited availability and high magical capacity.

Fossilized Bone Arrow.description: An arrow enhanced with pieces of Fossilized Bone. Strikingly beautiful and deadly.

Fossilized Bone Dust.description: Grinding the Fossilized Bone into dust frees its inherent magical attributes and makes it more handy for further production steps.

Fresh Shroud Spore.description: Fresh Shroud spores, used to craft medicines that can cure the Shroud curse.

Fried Rice.description: If pure, cooked rice is a bit too plain for you, then this fried rice might satisfy your needs. The added egg breaks up the granular texture of the rice, and the vegetables create a punch of flavor!

Frizzy Goat Milk.description: A delicious jug of Frizzy Goat milk. Drinking it will grant you endurance.

Frog.description: A tiny frog. He could be your best friend if you didn't need to use him as fishbait. Found in the Veilwater Basin and especially helpful to catch epic fish.

Frog In The Grass.description: Muted shades of green help you blend in, almost invisible as you chase little frogs through the grass This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

From Dusk Till Dawn.description: Through the dark night until dawn drapes the ski in golden - yellow and red hues. This color combination would look stunning on a flag too! This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Frostbite Slasher Boots.description: Heavy boots with metal caps, perfect for kicking down doors or crushing skulls under your heel.

Frostbite Slasher Chest.description: A breezy west layered on top of a long shirt. The additional belt buckle strapped across the chest holds some spare blades.

Frostbite Slasher Gloves.description: Padded gloves made from thick white cloth and deep blue leather arm guards. A small buckle and cyan string hold them together. The fingertips are left bare, so you can still feel the pulse of the hunt.

Frostbite Slasher Hood.description: The fearsome metal mask is only partially covered by the hood, leaving most of its sharp edges and lines visible to your prey.

Frostbite Slasher Trousers.description: This pair of pants has ample space for carrying exposed blades and hidden toxins.

Fruit Bowl.description: A refreshing bowl of fruits with positive health benefits.

Fur Boots.description: Warmer and sturdier than simple cloth.

Fur Chest.description: Reinforced with Metal Scraps for better protection.

Fur Gloves.description: Simple but reliable protection for hands.

Fur Hood.description: Simplistic head protection. It won't guard against much, but it's better than nothing.

Fur Rug.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Fur Trousers.description: A little archaic, but better than cloth.

Furry straw mat.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Gentian.description: A star-shaped blossom that blooms in the high-up mountains. It grants more spirit when consumed.

Gentian Seedling.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

Ghost Glider.description: A formidable Glider which can cross even the deepest trenches, allowing you to rain death from above.

Ghostly Shield.description: This magic shield allows you to block against physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

Giant Bone Arrow.description: An arrow made from giant bone.

Giant Bones.description: These bones are far larger than normal and are exceptionally sturdy.

Giant Critter Scales.description: Massive, hardened scales. Lightweight yet incredibly tough, they are prime materials for crafting durable and flexible armor.

Giant Hollow Halls Banner.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Giant Telescope.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Gilded Axe.description: A steel axe, decorated with gold accents. It makes you feel much stronger, although the blade itself is most likely not improved by much.

Gilded Contrast.description: White and black in bold opposition, with just a thread of gold to hold it all together. Minimal, but deliberate.

Gilded Depths.description: Dark as the deep end, a green so rich it swallows light. Balanced with a warm gold and bright turquoise.

Gilded Pickaxe.description: This steel pickaxe has been further refined through the addition of gold ornaments.

Ginger.description: Fresh ginger, perfect for brewing hot tea to keep any cold at bay.

Ginger In A Jungle.description: Rich, deep hues of green evoke the jungle and thickets you must navigate. A touch of red is added, like the red ginger flowers that appear here and there, breaking up the sea of green. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Ginger Plant Pot.description: A potted plant to beautify your home

Ginger Seedling.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

Ginger Tea.description: This ginger tea tastes like the paragon of good health.

Glass.description: A wondrous material. It is transparent and offers many potential applications, especially in building and crafting!

Glass Shards.description: Glass broken into pieces offers many sharp edges used to enhance weapons.

Gleam Root.description: An underwater plant that only grows where the moonlight coats the seafloor. It has an enticing glow that spells demise for any diver willing to forget themselves in their pursuit of the light in the deep.

Gleam Root Diving Light.description: A throwable light that activates upon landing, even underwater. Not as strong as other light sources.

Gleam Root Dust.description: This powder was derived from the Gleam Root plant, which only grows at night in the Veilwater Basin.

Glider.description: The possibility to fly has always been a desirable trait.

Glimmer Gentian.description: "Glimmer Gentian" is a variant of the gentian plant that can only be found in the Albaneve Summits at night. It emits a bright pink glow and can be used to create vibrant color palettes.

Glimmer Gentian Tea.description: This is an herbal tea with added glimmer gentian. The Blossoms create a smooth texture and extend your Time in the shroud.

Globe.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Gloomberry.description: A special berry that can only be harvested at night in the Revelwood. It can be used to enhance various dishes and to create deep blue pigments.

Glow Dust.description: A magical dust that can glow in the dark, consisting of the crushed remains of a Fire Fly.

Glow Soup.description: A weird brew emitting a blue glow...Nobody quite knows why.

Goalpost.description: A goalpost that can be activated via the Sparkworks system.

Goat Feeder.description: A feeding device that holds Goat food.

Goat Food.description: Nutritious Goat food for tame animals on your farm.

Goat Food Bait.description: Food for attracting and taming a Goat.

Gold Ancient S.P.D.R. Construct Trophy.description: The central eye remains visible, but no longer carries the pressure it once did. It now feels less like a weapon and more like a relic.

Gold Bars.description: Solid gold bars that serve as both a crafting material and a status symbol.

Gold Coins.description: Gold coins, ideal for bedazzling, boasting, and bribing.

Gold Cyclops Trophy.description: Possessing this trophy shows everyone that you are not on the Cyclops' menu — it's the other way around!

Gold Direwolf Trophy.description: The golden Direwolf does not show that it was victorious. it shows that you were.

Gold Dust.description: Gold ground to powder. It sparkles even more beautifully than before.

Gold Fell Crimson Critter Queen Trophy.description: Take this golden trophy as a sign of your multiple victories, but also remember: she won't stop staring back, she refuses to be covered, and to be forgotten.

Gold Fell Critter Queen Trophy.description: You have slain the Fell Critter Queen so many times that her golden trophy can embellish your walls. One could say you have earned the right to take her place and be the new Queen. But there was nobody left to rule.

Gold Fell Cyclops Trophy.description: There wasn't much substance to begin with, but now only the empty shell remains. Show off your pride with this golden trophy.

Gold Fell Dragon Youngling Trophy.description: As you were fighting the Fell Dragon Youngling time and time again, you could observe how its hope got whittled down to despair.

Gold Fell Monstrosity Trophy.description: Although you have been exposed to this sight countless times, it still exudes a sense of menace and excitement at the same time.

Gold Fell Sicklescythe Trophy.description: The moment before the final curse was spoken is frozen forever in this golden trophy. Thankfully, the incredible power of the flame is ever-present.

Gold Fell Striker Trophy.description: The severed, golden head, forever frozen in time, invites you to look within. To reach this moment, you had to perfect your fighting strategy. Well done.

Gold Fell Thunderbrute Trophy.description: Possessing this golden trophy proves that you dodged every sword blow and defeated your opponent with concentrated force.

Gold Fell Wispwyvern Trophy.description: Once thought to be a path to redemption turned into a path to damnation. Fortunately, the Flame was strong enough to avert greater disasters several times.

Gold Hollow Cyclops Trophy.description: The Hollow Cyclops would certainly be delighted with his gilded teeth, with which he would grin menacingly at you.

Gold Hollow Titan Trophy.description: The surface gleams so bright and the plume becomes a radiant crown, turning the helmet into something ceremonial. Fitting for celebrating your multiple defeats.

Gold Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy.description: At this point, you're a professional at not getting crushed by skeletal fury. and this trophy is proof of it.

Gold Hydrak'Dal Trophy.description: This trophy proves that you have defeated their leader once again. In their eyes, you must seem like a god. However, they won't worship you, they'll just despise you even more.

Gold In The Water.description: Want to look like a gold nuggest resting on the bottom of a lake? With this color palatte, you embody just that - rich, vibrant blues with a hint of sparkling gold. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Gold Ore.description: The most tantalizing gold ore is often hidden beneath the water's surface, but be careful when spotting a glint of golden light at the bottom of a stream. The gold rush may swallow you if the wave's don't

Gold Scavenger Matron Trophy.description: Completely gilded, you can no longer notice the dirt and stench, so you can hang it in your living room without hesitation.

Gold Scavenger Tyrant Trophy.description: For a moment, you're back on the battlefield. Her presence brings the same tension into the room, as if the fight never quite ended.

Gold Vorgoth's Eye Trophy.description: Gold smooths over the jagged form, giving it an almost sacred appearance. The tendrils resemble ornamental roots rather than organic tissue. This trophy shows you are the greatest Flameborn of all time, because you did not back down from fighting evil more than once. You did it multiple times and were successful.

Gold Vukah Brawler Trophy.description: Whoever owns this trophy has shown that even the strongest Vukah Brawler is no competition to them.

Golden Ball.description: This palette presents a multitude of yellow tones, vibrant as a polished golden ball or crown carried by a princess. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Golden Bulwark Boots.description: You've likely never work foot armor this light, but give it a shot - the chest plate's weight needs counterbalancing somewhere.

Golden Bulwark Chest Plate.description: A gold-plated chest plate, heavy and imposing - piercing it would be no easy task.

Golden Bulwark Gloves.description: Blocking feels effortless in these gloves, and the crystals catch the sun with every move.

Golden Bulwark Helmet.description: Just one look into these eyes and your enemies will want to turn the other way. That was your first line of defense, and you didn't have to lift a finger.

Golden Bulwark Pants.description: The pants might not look like much, but they actually do their job of protecting your life in battle.

Golden Bulwark Shield.description: A massive golden shield engraved with the snarling face of an ancient creature. Its fanged visage is said to ward off evil and strike fear into enemies on the battlefield.

Golden Curved Palisade.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Golden Dome.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Golden Fence.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Golden Leaf.description: Green and brown with a hint of gold, like raining leaves on a slow day in fall. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

Golden Room Divider.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Golden Steel Arrow.description: A refined steel-tipped arrow embellished with gold. With this, you can fight in style.

Golden Vase Of The Ancients I.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Golden Vase Of The Ancients II.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Golden Vase Of The Ancients III.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Gormander's War Banner I.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Gormander's War Banner II.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Grandleaf Cabbage.description: The gigantic leaves of this plant are as useful as they are gorgeous. They taste something like cabbage. ideal thinly sliced in a salad, or used as a wrap.

Grandleaf Cabbage Rolls.description: Hearty cabbage rolls made from the broad leaves of the ancient Grandleaf Cabbage, filled with seasoned meat.

Granite.description: A magmatic deep rock mostly consisting of feldspar, quartz, and mica.

Granite Fireplace.description: A fireplace that will provide warmth once placed in your home.

Granite Ornamented Roof Block.description: You can fashion a beautifully detailed, dark roof with this granite roof block.

Granite Rubble Road Block.description: A road material for building rocky mountain roads.

Granite Shingle Roof Block.description: These granite shingles bring a mountain flair to your cozy homestead.

Granite Stone Bathtub.description: A decorative item that can be placed in any building. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the rested buff.

Granite Window Frame.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Grapple Plant.description: A resilient herb, growing in the harsh Kindlewastes climate. Spiritualists were known to use it for mystical purposes.

Grapple Plant Seedling.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

Grappling Hook.description: A sturdy tool that can help to cross many chasms along the way.

Grappling Hook Pull Anchor.description: Add this pull anchor to your buildings to pull yourself forward and onto other platforms. Requires a Grappling Hook to activate.

Grappling Hook Swing Anchor.description: Add this swing anchor to your buildings to swing across chasms. Requires a Grappling Hook to activate.

Grasshopper.description: A resilient grasshopper that's adapted to the warm colors of the Nomad Highlands. It can be used as fishing bait, most likely to catch uncommon fish.

Graveyard Fence.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Graveyard Fence Broken I.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Graveyard Fence Broken II.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Graveyard Fence Pole.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Greater Antidote.description: An improved antidote that will cure poison and negate the next poisoning.

Greater Ectoplasm.description: This liquid was created by crushing ectoplasm shards and gathering the resulting goo. It's been filtered an is technically sterile.

Greater Ectoplasm Soup.description: This slimy soup was improved with some salt, slow-cooked broth, and the added aroma of fearing death.

Greater Health Potion.description: After finetuning the Health Potion, the ingredients were adjusted, instantly restoring a great amount of health upon consumption.

Greater Health Potion +.description: Instantly restores a medium amount of health, and continuosly heals for 10 seconds.

Greater Mana Potion.description: A mana potion with higher concentration, instantly restoring a great amount of mana upon use.

Greater Mana Potion +.description: Instantly restores a medium amount of mana, and continuously replenishes it for 10 seconds.

Greater Shroud Survival Flask.description: Contains cleansed Shroud Liquid, enhancing the resistance of the user. Extends the Maximum time in the shroud after consumption by 4 Minutes. This effect will last for 45 Minutes.

Green-Winged Orchid.description: This color palette's combination of light green and vibrant purple takes inspiration from extinct orchids. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

Green Fabric.description: The color of life - a wonderful color for clothes.

Green Luminescent Block.description: A building block crafted from purified slime. It illuminates the room with a ghostly green glow.

Green Rocket.description: These fireworks were brought to you by the wonders of alchemy!

Green Vitriol Dust.description: The end product of chemical experiments, the crystals sparkle like shimmering sea foam.

Grilled Algae Buds.description: These grilled algae buds can be sprinkled on your food to maximize flavor. They have added health benefits, too!

Grilled Bird Meat.description: A healthy protein rich snack. The color looks just perfect..

Grilled Cinderscale.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

Grilled Crab Meat.description: A generous portion of grilled meat. It must've come from a giant crab. Enjoy!

Grilled Crimsonback.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

Grilled Dune Armadillo.description: A specialty of the Kindlewastes - customers love it because of its health benefits!

Grilled Emberfin.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

Grilled Fatty Meat.description: Beautifully tender, juicy meat. It fills the belly and warms the soul by providing better frost resistance!

Grilled Fish with Coconut Rice.description: The light sweetness of the coconut rice pairs well with the smoky fish filet. A shame you couldn't add a hint of lime or lemon!

Grilled Game.description: A staple in many traditional Revelwood dishes. It has a rejuvenating effect.

Grilled Lakehopper.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

Grilled Lean Meat.description: Rich in protein and delicious, but only a small snack. Increases the Constitution of the user by a small margin.

Grilled Penny Bun.description: A smoky grilled mushroom that temporarily amplifies your magical power when eaten.

Grilled Wolf Meat.description: Roasted ribs were a delicacy back in the day, granting a good amount of Constitution to the consumer.

Grilled Yellowfin.description: Delicious, crispy grilled fish. Increases your health and diving time.

Grilled Yucca Fruit.description: When cooked, the Yucca Fruit becomes very sweet. Makes the mouth water and recovers Stamina.

Grinding Stones.description: A simple setup for basic grinding work. Especially good for hard ingredients.

Ground Coffee Beans.description: Ground coffee beans, ready to be brewed into an energizing cup of coffee!

Ground Lantern I.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the Rested Buff.

Ground Lantern II.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the Rested Buff.

Ground Sign.description: A standing sign that you can write on.

Guardian Boots.description: Hefty boots. They will leave considerable footprints in the ground when you defend those in need.

Guardian Chestplate.description: Prodigious tin armor. The glistening sheen inspires hope.

Guardian Gloves.description: Big and bulky gloves, usually worn when wielding large weaponry and shields.

Guardian Helmet.description: Seeing this helmet makes others feel safe and secure.

Guardian Shield.description: It's more than a shield - it's a bulwark of faith, a final sanctuary in the fray.

Guardian Trousers.description: Trousers that were made from a very stiff material.

Hailcaster Boots.description: These boots provide resistance and grip when stuck in a fierce snowstorm.

Hailcaster Chest.description: A carefully layered tunic, tied over the chest with gold string. The cloth is thick, but flowy. It will enable quick magical dashes while protecting you from the bitter cold.

Hailcaster Gloves.description: Simple layered gloves that allow for optimal versatility and swiftness when spellcasting.

Hailcaster Hat.description: A sophisticated crown that frames the wearer's head with a golden halo and amethyst sparks. It represents the dawning sun, bathing the mountainsides in a long-awaited morning glow.

Hailcaster Pants.description: Dark padded pants with golden seams. They're warm and comfortable.

Half-Timbered Block.description: Timbering is an ancient building technique that was very popular for its decorative effect.

Half-timbered Shell Limestone Block.description: The exposed wooden beams create a beautiful contrast to the rough surface, creating a feeling of warmth.

Half Wooden Barrel.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

Hand Drum.description: A simple percussion instrument used to play music. The little chimes add a nice flair to any song.

Hand Spindle.description: An item used by the Hunter to create better strings.

Handpan.description: A hang drum is a hand-played steel instrument whose gentle tones spread like ripples across still water.

Hanging Lantern.description: An illumination item that can be placed in your home. Provides comfort, increasing the duration of the Rested Buff.

Hanging Silver Chandelier.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

Hardened Leather.description: This patch of leather has been made more sturdy and enduring.

Hardwood.description: This especially tough wood could cause much damage if it hits your head while you fell trees.

Hardwood Ash Tree Seedling.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil.

Harp.description: A heavenly harp with silver strings, beloved by common folk and kings alike.

Harrow.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

Harvest Festival.description: A collection of bright oranges that exhibit a warm and inviting glow. This color palette can be made with Kindlewastes materials.

Hazelnut.description: A nice snack for the way. The strength it takes to crack its shell, it gives back upon consumption.

Hazelnut Bush Seedling.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested repeatedly.

Heal Beam Channel.description: Continuously heal a target in a beam up to 20 meters away.

Heal Cascade II.description: Releases continuous healing projectiles that automatically seek you and your allies.

Heal Channel.description: Magical ammunition that, upon use, releasing continuous healing projectiles.

Healer Boots.description: No need to keep these boots clean and neat. They will get bloody. Your teammates will make sure of that.

Healer Gloves.description: These gloves allow nimble fingers to patch up wounds in a pinch.

Healer Headwrap.description: A headwrap that protects your sensitive skull from traumatic injury. Enough to postpone the inevitable for a while.

Healer Pants.description: Woven pants which keep the wearer from scraping their knees.

Healer Tunic.description: A breathable tunic with ample space for bandages, herbs, and tissues.

Health Potion.description: Filled with vitalizing ingredients, it instantly restores a good amount of health.

Health Potion +.description: Instantly restores a small amount of health, and continuously heals for 10 seconds.

Heart's Desire.description: Burning reds, crimson as a passionate kiss - or the blood of a weeping heart, pierced by a lance This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Heart Pillow.description: A soft velvet heart-shaped pillow, bringing not only comfort but a luxurious, elegant look to any space.

Hemotoxin Antidote.description: Removes Hemotoxin debuff upon use. Also applies a buff that prevents the hemotoxin from affecting the user for an hour.

Herbal Mountain Tea.description: A strong, herbal tea. It increases your mana and stamina.

Herbalist Boots.description: Quickly dash to the rescue in these comfortable and snug boots !

Herbalist Gloves.description: These fingerless gloves allow the weaver to feel each leaf and root before picking, allowing a proper assessment.

Herbalist Headwrap.description: Headgear for herbalists. Healing others is suprisingly hard when you can't actually see them.

Herbalist Pants.description: Some plain herbalist pants. They smell like rosemary and thyme.

Herbalist Tunic.description: Classic herbalist garb with widened pockets for storing healing tinctures.

Hero's Shield.description: This basic shield allows you to block physical attacks. Blocking drains stamina.

Highly Polished Stone Block.description: A stone block refined with the highest level of craftsmanship, rarely seen even in ancient times.

Hollow's Eve Banner.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Hollow Cyclops Head.description: Its only eye still aimlessly rolled around in its socket before the beheading. Eventually, though, it spilled out.

Hollow Cyclops Trophy.description: The frozen horns made from ectoplasm don't melt near the hearth fire. They must be magical!

Hollow Halls Block.description: The characteristic building material used inside the Hollow Halls. The originators of this architectural style are unknown and forgotten.

Hollow Halls Showcase (1 Large Slot).description: This is a showcase for Hollow Artifact Collection Items usually found in the Hollow Halls

Hollow Titan Head.description: The Hollow Titan wears no face, only a featureless mask, with his plume swaying slightly with each step.

Hollow Titan Trophy.description: The bare helmet of the Hollow Titan. At its crown rises a stiff plume.

Hollow Wispwyvern Head.description: It broke your bones with bones. Seemed only fair to take a few of its own. The head's still intact. makes for a decent trophy.

Hollow Wispwyvern Trophy.description: You stare at the skull and swear the floor trembles. It doesn't. Yet.

Hollow Wretch II.description: Summons a Hollow Wretch ally that attacks enemies. Maximum amount of summoned Hollow allies is 1 by default which can be increased via skills.

Holly and Berry.description: This color palette is energetic and festive, evoking lush foliage and joyful celebrations This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Homage To Drak Slurp.description: A bright green color palette, reminiscent of algae, shrubbery, and Drak cuisine This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Honey.description: The following sugar rush recharges stamina!

Honey Baked Banana.description: The banana and honey combine to create smooth and creamy sweetness. A delicacy for any Flameborn with a sweet tooth!

Hophare Feeder.description: A feeding device that holds Hophare food.

Hophare Food.description: Nutritious Hophare food for tame animals on your farm.

Hophare Food Bait.description: Food for attracting and taming a Hophare.

Hophare Pillow.description: A cosy pillow with a Hophare design on it. The animal looks so lively that you think it may leap from the fabric at any moment!

Horizontal Banner I.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Horizontal Banner II.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Huge Chest.description: A big and heavy chest that offers fantastic storage space for countless items.

Huge Crypt Door.description: A decorative object to design and beautify your home.

Huge Magic Chest.description: A big and heavy chest that offers fantastic storage space for countless items.

Hunter Boots.description: These boots are ideal for stalking prey.

Hunter Gloves.description: These leather gloves have been adorned with metal to protect the weaver's knuckles.

Hunter Hood.description: Remain unseen and strike from the shadows with this formidable archer's hood.

Hunter Trousers.description: Nothing is more suitable for a long prowl than this set of pants.

Hunter Vest.description: Taking down prey, and even other predators, is far easier with this finely made hunter's armor.

Hydrak'Dal Head.description: The head of a Drak'Dal tribe leader. You've severed it from its neck, but in its place, two new ones will form — figuratively speaking.

Hydrak'Dal Trophy.description: A severed Hydrak'Dal Head with the regal headdress. Even now, it still exudes authority and a will to dominate.

Ice Bolt I.description: Magical ammunition that creates a single bolt of ice, damaging enemies upon impact and slowing them afterwards.

Ice Bolt II.description: Improved ammunition that creates a single bolt of ice, damaging enemies upon impact and slowing them afterwards.

Ice Bolt III.description: Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.

Ice Bolt IV.description: Conjures an icy projectile that deals damage in an area and applies a slow debuff.

Ice Protection Lotion.description: A lotion that protects you from the cold seeping in. It grants its user +1 ice armor per level.

Moonstone Arrow.description: An arrow with a precisely polished moonstone tip.

Moonstone Block.description: A solid block of shimmering moonstone. It's cool to the touch and it catches light beautifully.

Moonstone Dust.description: Fine particles that shimmer faintly, leaving a cold blue trace on whatever they settle on.

Moss.description: A lovely patch of green moss. It can be used for highly effective bandages.

Moth.description: An inconspicuous moth ripped from its natural ecosystem to be used as an alchemic ingredient. Can only be found at night in the fields of the Revelwood.

Mother-Of-Pearl.description: The natural iridescent material that pearls are made of, it can be found lining the inside of certain shells and valued for its luminous shimmer.

Mountain's Shadow Boots.description: These boots repeat the same weaving technique from the Mountain's Shadow Gloves. They cover the knees and provide ideal protection when stumbling through dark, icy caves or forgotten fortresses.

Mountain's Shadow Chest.description: No matter where you turn, the celestial crags of the mountainside always crast a dark shadow over the valleys. With this piece of armor, you can blend into the dark and travel lightly like a freezing gust of wind to find your enemies.

Mountain's Shadow Gloves.description: Dark leather patterned arm guards wrapped in ashen grey strings. Wool padding peeks out from beneath them when wielding your weapon fiercly.

Mountain's Shadow Helmet.description: A gloomy helmet, hiding an even darker gaze. The crest around the brow casts a shadow over the wearer's eyes, hiding their intention.

Mountain's Shadow Shield.description: A shield with a central amethyst. The metal frame around the sides makes it more durable.

Plaguebringer Gloves.description: These traditional archer gloves were made asymmetrical through multiple monstrous tusks and bone shards jutting outwards.

Plaguebringer Hood.description: Putrescence laps the side of this brown hood, like a wave of pestilence crashing to shore.Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

Plaguebringer Trousers.description: Leather pants with noticeable grain that morphs into fine fungal tendrils.Offers extended protection against the Shroud.

Plant Fiber.description: Maybe they can be used as strings? They seem to be pretty robust.

Plant Fiber Roof Block.description: Used to build thatched roofs. A basic and reliable solution to keep your head from getting wet.

Plantain.description: This plantain, not to be confused with a common banana, cannot be eaten raw. It's high in starch and can be used as a staple in many foods once cooked.

Plantain Curry.description: A creamy curry made from plantain, rice, coconut milk, and vegetables. It's tart, earthy, and quite filling.

Plantain Salad with Aurora Beans.description: A hearty salad of cooked and roasted plantains, chopped vegetables, and aurora beans. Simple ingredients, satisfying results.

Plough.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

Pocket Heater.description: After ignition the leather limits the amount of air around the coal, causing it to burn slower. This will keep you warm for a bit.

Pretty In Pink.description: These vivid colors - deep cyan, bright magenta, and rich black - make a statement all on their own. With this palette, you won't go unnoticed. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Prickle Pearl.description: An ancient crossbreed that reminds you of a pomegranate or a fig that started to sprout. but the whiskers tickle conspicuously in the throat.

Prickle Pearl Tart.description: A buttery shortcrust pastry tart filled with fresh Prickle Pearls. Delicate and sweet with that unmistakable tickle on the tongue.

Quetzal Hunter Chest.description: As Quetzals no longer roam Embervale, dyed palm laves are used in place of their feathers to recreate the look.

Quetzal Hunter Gloves.description: These gauntlets shield your arms as you chase through the undergrowth, striking foes from afar.

Quetzal Hunter Helmet.description: Inspired by the Quetzal, a magnificent bird that once graced the skies of Embervale, this beautiful armor set lets you feel the freedom and precision of flight when you wear it.

Quetzal Hunter Pants.description: They let you sprint through the thicket with the swiftness of wings.

Quetzal Hunter Shoes.description: In these shoes, you glide through the thicket effortlessly, barely breaking a sweat.

Quick Stack Station.description: Used to transfer items from your backpack to matching magic chest stacks nearby.

Ragged Boots.description: They can barely be called boots.

Ragged Pants.description: Enough to brace for the worst of it, until better armor crosses your path.

Ragged Shirt.description: Can this even be called a shirt?

Rake.description: A rake made of the simplest materials. A basic tool used to flatten the ground for upcoming construction works.

Ranger Boots.description: These boots were made for those wishing to lurk quietly through the thicket.

Ranger Gloves.description: Simple gloves made from ethically sourced organic leather.

Ranger Hood.description: A hood that provides additional protection from the sun, allowing you to focus your gaze undisturbed.

Ranger Trousers.description: Pants which shield the legs from brambles and thorns while hunting down prey.

Ranger Vest.description: This piece of armor only offers minor protection against incoming arrows, but that hardly matters. The best preventative measure is to aim for the eyes.

Rare Fishing Bait.description: Bait that increases the chance of catching rare fish.

Raw Bird Meat.description: It's not properly cooked. Eating this raw would cause nausea.

Raw Dune Armadillo Meat.description: Fleshy and tough. Better not eat it like this.

Raw Fatty Meat.description: A tender, raw slab of fatty meat. It is uncooked, and therefore not consumable.

Raw Game.description: Uncooked game. Must be roasted over a fire.

Raw Lean Meat.description: Inedible, raw meat. Must be cooked over a campfire.

Raw Meat and Azure Russula Skewer.description: This mushroom skewer will strengthen not only your flesh but also your mind.

Raw Meat and Forest Beet Skewer.description: A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision.

Raw Meat and Hazelnut Skewer.description: A hearty feast that fortifies your body.

Raw Meat and Tomato Skewer.description: A hunter's favorite ration, crafted for precision. After you've grilled it over a fire, it will grant you more maximum health, increase your ranged and dagger damage, and expand your maximum stamina.

Raw Rice.description: Grains of raw rice. They'll be very filling once cooked.

Raw Taro.description: A delicious root vegetable that must be cooked before its sweet and mild flavor can be enjoyed.

Raw Wolf Meat.description: Raw Wolf meat. Must be cooked for proper consumption.

Raw Wool.description: Raw wool. It's fluffy, easily knotted, and smells vaguely earthy. It needs to be processed further to be used for garments and armor.

Regular Sandstone Block.description: A Regular Sandstone Block. It's very cost - efficient.

Reptile Leather.description: A sturdy material used in extravagant tailoring.

Resin Torch.description: An advanced torch that provides light for a longer period. Use this to explore deeper into the abyss!

Resource Bundle II.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

Revelation By The Pond.description: Still waters are deep, so they say. These serene blue hues remind us that things aren’t as they seem - for both depths and dewdroppee thicket hide fateful encounters. This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Revelwood Bone Key.description: Opens doors in the Revelwood Hollow Halls.

Revelwood Rubble.description: A mix of different biome-specific materials, mainly stone and dirt.

Revelwood Stone.description: The best stories start small. For example with a stone.

Revitalizing Health Potion.description: The pinnacle of potioncraft. It gained its name after rescuing users from countless near-death situations. Instantly restores an unbelievable amount of health.

Revitalizing Health Potion +.description: Instantly restores a lot of health, and continuosly heals for 10 seconds.

Rice Seedling.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant once sown in the right soil. This plant needs to be placed in water, so that the roots are always covered.

Rising Fighter Boots.description: Footwork is the most important skill of swordsmanship. These boots should make learning the first steps easier.

Rising Fighter Chest.description: Light, polstered and ready to take a few hits - the perfect chest armor for begginer.

Rising Fighter Gloves.description: Gloves made for beginner fighters. Robust, but agile. They will mainly protect you from blisters when swinging your sword.

Rising Fighter Helmet.description: A head piece to keep your skull safe when diving into battle.

Rising Fighter Shield.description: Even a simple shield such as this can save your life when you get surrounded, or surprised.

Rising Fighter Trousers.description: Polstered trousers to dampen your fall in fighting practice.

Roasted Azure Russula.description: Watery and a little strange, this mushroom's odd taste comes from pure magic coursing throughout. Great power awaits the consumer.

Roasted Coffee Beans.description: A handful of roasted coffee beans. They smell chocolaty and rich, with a light note of floral sweetness. They must be ground up before brewing.

Roasted Corncob.description: Roasted with a smoky aroma, it's a real pleasure for the taste buds, able to set free all of its strengthening attributes.

Roasted Shiitake Mushroom.description: A roasted shiitake mushroom. The new, smoky aftertaste brings out the umami flavor.

Rocky Shore.description: The deep blue hue that takes center stage in this palette can be found beyond rocky beaches, or on rainy days by the cliff. This color palette can be made with Revelwood materials.

Rocky Stone Road Block.description: A rugged-looking stone road material made from jagged rocks. Be careful where you step!

Rogue Boots.description: Adventures who wear these fearsome boots should not be messed with.

Rogue Chestplate.description: A well - balanced chest piece that lets the wearer regenerate their energy faster.

Shroud Spores.description: Shroud Spores are particles of energy that create and give the shroud its corrupting power.

Water Well.description: A near unlimited source of water.

Watering Can.description: A useful item for watering thirsty flowers and plants.

Waveborne Ritualist Boots.description: With this footwear, the healing power of the earth flows straight through you -- can you feel it?

Waveborne Ritualist Gloves.description: Golden adornments define this set -- and naturally, the gloves are no exception.

Waveborne Ritualist Helmet.description: The mask veils the face, but not the intent. You are here to keep one safe.

Waveborne Ritualist Pants.description: With their simplicity, these pants bring balance to the outfit and allow the wearer's presence to shine.

Waveborne Ritualist Tunic.description: A magnificent aquamarine gleams upon this garment, said to amplify the wearer's healing abilities.

Waveleaper.description: The Waveleaper dances atop the waves with unmatched agility, a living embodiement of the waters untamed spirit.

Waves Of Valor.description: A vivid palette of bright blue, blazing red, and pure white - crisp, bold, and full of energy, like a banner snapping in the wind This color palette can be made with Veilwater Basin materials.

Wax.description: A common ingredient with a smooth consistency. Needed for illumination of all sorts.

Wax Torch.description: A very durable and long-lasting source of light made from wax. Equip this before starting your expeditions into the unknown!

Weathered Ancient Stone Block.description: This block has an aesthetic that is exclusive to the Blackmire. Only this biome's unique flora and humidity can make Ancient stones weather like this.

Weathered Stone Block.description: In ancient times, these blocks were used to build dungeons and catacombs. Nowadays, they are in bad condition, but still serve their purpose.

Well Block.description: Bathed in waterproofing liquids, this stone block is mostly used for Elixir Wells.

Wheat Grains.description: Both a cooking ingredient and a seed for the fields.

Wheat Seedling.description: A seedling that will grow into a plant when sown in the right soil. Once fully grown, it can be harvested once.

Wheel Barrow.description: A decorative object to beautify your home.

Whiskerfin.description: This bottom-dwelling fish is known for its long whiskers, which it uses to sense movement and food in the water. Apparently, it sensed your bait too. It can be eaten raw, but will be even more beneficial when processed further.

White Cymbidum Flower Pot.description: A lovely pot of flowers to beautify your world.

White Glowing Substance.description: This material glows in a warm white light. It's an alchemical miracle!

Wolf's Fang Hood.description: A hood fashioned from the scalp of a white wolf. The fangs at the front are still attached.

Wolf's Fang Shield.description: An oval shield with a regal aura. When your enemies see your eyes peak up from the safety of the shield, they are merely seconds away from taking their last breath.

Wolf's Fang Trousers.description: A pair of pants with leather greaves. They don't rustle while moving and muffle every little sound while sneaking around.
